title: Adavadi
desc: An arrogant filmmaker's life shatters when an actress, who is madly in love with him, cajoles him and makes him fall in love with her, but leaves him for another man.

title: Narasimhan IPS
desc: A retired police officer gets trapped in the crossfire of a political rivalry and is imprisoned for admitting to murder. However, his sons-in-law set out to find the real culprit.

title: Enn Purusan Kuzhantai Mathuri
desc: A man gets involved with another woman just a day before he is to get married. After marriage, he lands in trouble when he confesses his mistake to his wife.

title: Seevalaperi Pandi
desc: Five villagers, unhappy with the judgments of the chief of their village, join forces with his bodyguard Pandi to kill him. But Pandi gets capital punishment while the others are acquitted.

title: Youth
desc: While travelling to Goa, a group of youngsters witness water scarcity in one of the villages. When they decide to do something about it, politics and bureaucracy come in their way.
